description: Finds a free to read copy of one paper and returns the link, preferring a PDF over a landing page. When OpenAlex has no free copy it says so in plain words instead of failing. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807). Example prompt: 'find a free PDF of this paper, DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

paper.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807.

name: find_open_access_pdf
title: Find a free copy
